properties.description: Paving Operations on LA-347 Both Directions from Park Ave to LA-349.  Lane Affected. Starting 5/12/2025 6:00 AM
properties.details:
ST. MARTIN, La. - The Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development (DOTD) announces that beginning on May 12, 2025, construction will commence on a $10.06 million dollar project along a 2.98-mile stretch of La. 347, from La. 351 to La. 328, in St. Martin Parish.

PROJECT SCOPE
This project consists of milling, in-place base rehab, asphalt concrete overlay, drainage improvements and related work.

WORK SCHEDULE
The work is estimated to take place Mondays through Fridays from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., weather permitting.

TRAVEL IMPACTS
Motorists will encounter intermittent lane closures beginning Wednesday, April 23, 2025 to allow utilities to be relocated for this project.

Once construction begins, intermittent lane closures will also be required to perform the work. Therefore, drivers should expect delays.

Emergency vehicles will have access through this area.

The road will be open to regular traffic with a 11-foot lane restriction on oversized loads passing through the work zone.

The project is estimated to be complete August 2026.

SAFETY REMINDER
DOTD appreciates your patience and reminds you to please drive with caution through the construction site and be on the lookout for work crews and their equipment.

properties.details:
Traffic Shift Scheduled for LA 70 in Ascension, St. James Parish
Ascension Parish, La.- The Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development (DOTD) announces a new traffic configuration on LA 70 between LA 22 and the Sunshine Bridge, scheduled to begin at 4 a.m. on Tuesday, June 10, 2025.

Traffic will shift into a split-lane configuration to accommodate ongoing construction. Westbound traffic will use the outside lane of the existing LA 70 alignment, while eastbound traffic will use the outside lane of the newly constructed LA 70 alignment. This change will require motorists to travel on both the old and new portions of LA 70. Driveway and roadway access along the corridor may be modified, and drivers should remain alert.

In addition, the traffic signal at the intersection of LA 70 and LA 3125 will be removed, and the intersection will be converted to a permanent roundabout. Motorists are urged to proceed with caution through the new configuration.

The lane shift is necessary to allow the contractor to complete median work and pave the final layer of asphalt on the inside lanes of LA 70. During this phase, oversized or permitted loads exceeding 12 feet in width will not be allowed through the work zone. Drivers should contact the DOTD Permit Office to obtain alternate routing.

Project update:
Following the traffic shift, construction crews will move into the final phase of the project. Remaining tasks include milling and overlaying the westbound lanes of LA 70 from the Ascension-St. James Parish line to the Sunshine Bridge, as well as paving the final wearing course on the eastbound lanes between the Sunshine Bridge and LA 22.

Additional work includes forming and pouring the center island and red concrete truck apron at the LA 70/LA 3125 roundabout, installing concrete islands at LA 70 and Raymond Tullier Road, and paving associated turnouts, turn lanes, crossovers, and driveways. properties.description: Bridge Construction on Ches Courville Rd Both Directions from Freeman Dr to Dupuis Rd . All lanes closed. Starting 11/2/2026 8:00 AM
properties.details:
DOTD announces the upcoming replacement of a bridge on Ches Courville Road, 0.10 miles south of LA 352 (Henderson Highway) in St. Martin Parish.

The project, part of DOTD’s Off-System Bridge Program, represents an investment of approximately $1.59 million.

Construction is scheduled to begin Monday, November 2, 2026. The project includes the removal of the existing timber bridges, installation of a new concrete slab-span bridge, and associated roadway work.

The closure is expected to remain in place through Thursday, April 2027, to allow crews to safely remove and replace the existing bridge.

No detour route will be posted, and emergency vehicles will not have access through the construction area. Motorists should plan accordingly and seek alternate routes.

The project is anticipated to be completed in May 2027, weather permitting.

properties.details:
The Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development announces a project to improve and repair a portion of LA 1 in Simmesport, Avoyelles Parish.
The project includes full-depth base repairs, milling to remove the old asphalt, new asphalt paving, new roadway striping, and related work.

Motorists should anticipate intermittent lane closures on LA 1 to allow construction activities to proceed safely and efficiently. Drivers are urged to pay close attention to advance warning signage, lowered speed limits, and crews & equipment on site.

All work on the project is anticipated to be complete in Summer 2027, with progress dependent on weather conditions and other factors that can impact construction timelines.

Lane restrictions: DOTD advises motorists that a 16 foot lane width restriction for this project has been implemented.

All vehicles larger than 16 feet will need to utilize an alternate route.
